source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 18 (PDF 83-114), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Inheritance) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a true-breeding plant? Which plant did Mendel develop true-breeding varieties of?
(True-breeding paudha kya hai? Mendel ne kis paude ki true-breeding qismein tayyar keen?)
blocks.explanation: True-breeding (pure-breeding) paudha self-fertilization par tamam aulad mein wohi trait deta hai. Mendel ne matar (pea) ke paudon ki true-breeding qismein tayyar keen.

book_ref.quote: A plant which is true-breeding for a particular trait

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between a dominant trait and a recessive trait, with Mendel's seed-shape example.
(Dominant aur recessive trait mein farq likhein, Mendel ki seed-shape misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Dono aik sifat ke mutabadil traits hain; dominant F1 mein zahir hota hai aur recessive wahan chhupa rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: He called the trait that expressed in the F1 plants

rows: Jo trait F1 paudon mein zahir ho
Mutabadil trait jo F1 mein zahir na ho
F2 ke 1/4 mein wapas aata hai

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is the 3:1 ratio of Mendel's F2 called a disguised 1:2:1 ratio?
(Mendel ke F2 ke 3:1 ratio ko chhupa hua 1:2:1 ratio kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke F2 ke 3/4 dominant paude sab aik jaise nahi: 1/4 pure-breeding dominant aur 2/4 ghair pure-breeding dominant hain, jabke 1/4 pure-breeding recessive. Is liye 3:1 asal mein 1:2:1 hai.

book_ref.quote: His results suggested that the 3:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
4 State the two points of the chromosomal theory of inheritance. Who proposed it?
(Chromosomal theory of inheritance ke do nukaat likhein. Yeh kis ne pesh ki?)
blocks.explanation:
Walter Sutton (1902) ne pesh ki:
1. Genes chromosomes par khaas jagahon par hote hain.
2. Meiosis mein chromosomes ka rawaiya Mendel ke qawaneen ki wazahat karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Genes are found at specific locations on chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
5 How did Mendel explain the control of characters by 'factors'?
(Mendel ne 'factors' ke zariye sifaat ke control ki wazahat kaise ki?)
blocks.explanation: Sifaat khaas 'factors' (ab genes) control karte hain. Har fard diploid hai aur har sifat ke do genes rakhta hai; haploid gametes bante waqt har gamete ko har sifat ka aik gene milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each individual is diploid and has two genes for a character

blocks.prompt:
6 Give the modern definition of a gene. What is a locus?
(Gene ki jadeed definition dein. Locus kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene DNA ka hissa nucleotides ka silsila hai jo polypeptide banane ka code deta hai. Chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah us ka locus (maqam) hai.

book_ref.quote: We now know that a gene is

blocks.prompt:
7 State the law of segregation.
(Law of segregation bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab fard gametes banata hai to har gamete ko gene ki sirf aik copy (allele) ittefaqan milti hai. Gametes milne par naye fard ka genotype gametes ke alleles se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the individual forms gametes, each gamete receives just one gene copy

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a testcross? Why is a round-seeded pea plant test-crossed with a wrinkled one?
(Testcross kya hai? Round beej wale matar ke paude ko wrinkled se testcross kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Testcross dominant phenotype ko recessive phenotype se cross karna hai taake pata chale ke woh homozygous hai ya heterozygous. Round paudha RR ya Rr ho sakta hai, wrinkled hamesha rr, is liye rr se cross us ka genotype batata hai.

book_ref.quote: A testcross is used to determine whether a dominant phenotype is homozygous or heterozygous

blocks.prompt:
9 Compare the testcross results of an RR and an Rr round-seeded plant.
(RR aur Rr round beej wale paudon ke testcross nataij ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Testcross ka natija batata hai ke round paudha homozygous hai ya heterozygous.

book_ref.quote: To determine its genotype, the round-seeded plant is crossed with a wrinkled-seeded plant

blocks.prompt:
10 Which two characters did Mendel study in his dihybrid cross? Write the dominant and recessive forms.
(Mendel ne dihybrid cross mein kaun si do sifaat parhein? Dominant aur recessive shaklein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Beej ki shakal: round (R) dominant, wrinkled (r) recessive.
2. Beej ka rang: yellow (Y) dominant, green (y) recessive.

book_ref.quote: He established pure-breeding lines for these traits

blocks.prompt:
11 What gametes does an F1 dihybrid (RrYy) produce, and how many F2 combinations do they give?
(F1 dihybrid (RrYy) kaun se gametes banata hai aur yeh F2 mein kitne combinations dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar gametes banata hai: RY, Ry, rY aur ry. 4 male × 4 female gametes F2 mein 16 combinations dete hain jin mein chaar phenotypes 9:3:3:1 hain.

book_ref.quote: When these gametes combine (4 male × 4 female gametes)

blocks.prompt:
12 State Mendel's law of independent assortment.
(Mendel ka law of independent assortment bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Gamete bante waqt alleles ka har jora doosre joron se azadana assort hota hai. Mendel ne yeh dihybrid ke is natije par rakha ke seed shape ke genes seed colour ke genes se azadana assort hote hain.

book_ref.quote: each pair of alleles assorts independently of other pairs of alleles during gamete formation

blocks.prompt:
13 Show that independent assortment does not affect the segregation of each allele pair in the dihybrid F2.
(Dikhayein ke dihybrid F2 mein independent assortment har allele jore ki segregation par asar nahi karta.)
blocks.explanation: F2 (9:3:3:1) mein round = 9 + 3 = 12 aur wrinkled = 3 + 1 = 4, yani round : wrinkled = 3:1. Isi tarah yellow = 12 aur green = 4, yani yellow : green = 3:1.

book_ref.quote: Independent assortment of different genes does not affect the segregation of individual allele pairs

blocks.prompt:
14 How does independent assortment act as a source of variation?
(Independent assortment variation ka zariya kaise hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meiosis mein homologous jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain, jis se gametes mein maan aur baap ke alleles ke mukhtalif combinations bante hain; insaan mein 8 million (2²³) se zyada. Fertilization in munfarid gametes ko munfarid zygote mein jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: Independent assortment of alleles creates genetic diversity

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is genetic diversity produced by mixing of alleles useful for a species?
(Alleles ke milne se paida hone wala genetic tanawwo species ke liye kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gamete banne aur fertilization par alleles ka musalsal milna population mein genetic tanawwo paida karta hai jo species ko badalte mahaul mein dhalne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This continuous mixing of alleles in a population creates genetic diversity

blocks.text: 18.2.1 Limitations to the Law of Independent Assortment

blocks.prompt:
16 How do chromosome crossover and epistasis limit the law of independent assortment?
(Chromosome crossover aur epistasis law of independent assortment ko kaise mehdood karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chromosome crossover meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan genetic maadda badalta hai, is liye combinations mutawaqqa ratio mein nahi aate. Epistasis mein aik gene ka asar doosre genes badal ya daba dete hain, is se bhi ratio badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to this process, the ratio of gene combinations may not be as predicted

blocks.prompt:
17 What is pleiotropy? How does it affect independent assortment?
(Pleiotropy kya hai? Yeh independent assortment par kya asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pleiotropy woh amal hai jis mein aik gene kai sifaat control karta hai, is liye yeh sifaat aik gene se jur jati hain. Yeh independent assortment ke mutawaqqa phenotypic ratios bigaar sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Pleiotropy can distort the expected phenotypic ratios from independent assortment

blocks.prompt:
18 Why are probability rules used instead of a Punnett square for crosses like AaBbCcDdEe × AaBbCcDdEe?
(AaBbCcDdEe × AaBbCcDdEe jaise crosses ke liye Punnett square ke bajaye probability ke usool kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Genes ki muntaqili ittefaqi hai, is liye naye combinations probability se nikalte hain. Punnett square aik do genes ke liye theek hai magar zyada genes ke liye bohat pecheeda ho jata hai, is liye probability ke usool lagte hain.

book_ref.quote: The transfer of genes from one generation to the other is random

blocks.prompt:
19 Out of 3,200 pea seeds, 800 are green. Find the probability of a green seed.
(3,200 matar ke beejon mein se 800 green hain. Green beej ki probability nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Probability = waqia kitni dafa hua ÷ kul nataij = 800 ÷ 3,200 = 0.25, yani taqreeban 4 mein se 1 beej.

book_ref.quote: For example, if wrinkled pea seeds appear 1,850 times out of 7,324 seeds

blocks.prompt:
20 Using the product rule, find the probability of an aabb offspring from AaBb × AaBb.
(Product rule se AaBb × AaBb mein aabb aulad ki probability nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: P(aa) = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4 aur P(bb) = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4. Genes azadana assort hote hain, is liye P(aabb) = (1/4) × (1/4) = 1/16.

book_ref.quote: So, probability of aa offspring = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between the product rule and the sum rule of probability.
(Probability ke product rule aur sum rule mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Product rule azad waqiat ko jorta hai; sum rule mutually exclusive waqiat ko.

book_ref.quote: The probability of either event is found by adding

rows: Do ya zyada azad waqiat jo ikatthe hon
Mutually exclusive waqiat (aik waqt mein sirf aik)

blocks.prompt:
22 What is complete dominance? Give the pea example.
(Complete dominance kya hai? Matar ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Complete dominance mein dominant allele poora zahir hota hai aur recessive bilkul nahi. Yy matar mein Y (yellow) poora zahir hai aur y nahi, is liye Yy beej yellow hain.

book_ref.quote: Many traits do not show complete dominance

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between complete dominance and incomplete dominance.
(Complete dominance aur incomplete dominance mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai ke heterozygote mein dominant allele kitna zahir hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This is called complete dominance

rows: Dominant allele poora zahir, recessive bilkul nahi
Koi allele doosre par poora dominant nahi
Heterozygote dominant parent jaisa lagta hai
Heterozygote dono parents ke darmiyan hota hai
Misaal: Yy matar ke beej yellow
Misaal: RW four-o'clock ke phool pink

blocks.prompt:
24 How does the cross of red and white Japanese four-o'clock plants show incomplete dominance?
(Japanese four-o'clock ke red aur white paudon ka cross incomplete dominance kaise dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Red (RR) × white (WW) se tamam aulad pink (RW) hoti hai jo parents ke darmiyan hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke na R na W poora dominant hai.

book_ref.quote: This shows neither the alleles for red (R) nor of white (W) is completely dominant

blocks.prompt:
25 Why are the genotype ratio and the phenotype ratio the same in the F2 of four-o'clock plants?
(Four-o'clock ke F2 mein genotype aur phenotype ratio aik jaise kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke incomplete dominance mein har genotype ka apna phenotype hai: RR red, RW pink aur WW white. Is liye RW × RW se 1 RR : 2 RW : 1 WW aur 1 red : 2 pink : 1 white aata hai.

book_ref.quote: the result is red (RR), pink (RW), and white (WW) in a 1:2:1 ratio

blocks.prompt:
26 Name the alleles of the MN blood group and the antigens they produce. How many blood groups result?
(MN blood group ke alleles aur un ke banaye antigens ke naam likhein. Kitne blood groups bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Allele Lᴹ M antigen aur allele Lᴺ N antigen banata hai. Co-dominant hone se teen groups bante hain: M (LᴹLᴹ), N (LᴺLᴺ) aur MN (LᴹLᴺ).

book_ref.quote: So, the products of both alleles appear together in the phenotype of heterozygous

blocks.prompt:
27 Why are the MN alleles written with 'L', and why is the system also called MNS?
(MN alleles 'L' ke saath kyun likhe jate hain, aur system ko MNS kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 'L' Landsteiner aur Levine ke liye hai jinhon ne 1927 mein yeh system daryaft kiya. Ise MNS kehte hain kyunke MN aur S/s groups ke genes aik chromosome par linked hain.

book_ref.quote: the scientists who discovered this system in 1927

blocks.prompt:
28 Write the genotypes of the four ABO blood groups.
(Chaar ABO blood groups ke genotypes likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. A: IᴬIᴬ ya Iᴬi
2. B: IᴮIᴮ ya Iᴮi
3. AB: IᴬIᴮ
4. O: ii

book_ref.quote: It is controlled by one gene (I gene) with three alleles

blocks.prompt:
29 Why does the ABO system show both multiple alleles and co-dominance?
(ABO system multiple alleles aur co-dominance dono kyun dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Multiple alleles is liye ke aik gene (I) ke population mein teen alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i hain. Co-dominance is liye ke IᴬIᴮ (blood group AB) mein Iᴬ aur Iᴮ dono ikatthe zahir hote hain.

book_ref.quote: In human ABO blood group system, the alleles

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a blood group system? Name the two most important systems.
(Blood group system kya hai? Do sab se ahem systems ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Blood group system RBCs par khaas antigens ki mojoodgi se khoon ki darja bandi hai. Sab se ahem ABO system (A, B, AB, O) aur doosra Rh system (Rh-positive aur Rh-negative) hai.

book_ref.quote: A blood group system is a way of classifying blood

blocks.prompt:
31 Name the well-known antigens of the Duffy and Lewis blood group systems.
(Duffy aur Lewis blood group systems ke mashhoor antigens ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Duffy: Fyᵃ, Fyᵇ aur Fy³. Lewis: Leᵃ aur Leᵇ. Yeh systems aam tor par transfusion mein milan ka masla nahi banate.

book_ref.quote: Other major blood group systems

blocks.prompt:
32 Describe briefly how the four ABO blood groups were discovered and named.
(Mukhtasar batayein ke chaar ABO blood groups kaise daryaft hue aur naam diye gaye.)
blocks.explanation: 1901 mein Landsteiner ne RBCs par antigen-A aur antigen-B aur dono ke baghair log paye; baad mein us ke shagirdon ne dono wale log paye. Naam: A (antigen-A), B (antigen-B), AB (dono) aur O (koi nahi).

book_ref.quote: He also observed that many individuals do not have any of these antigens

blocks.prompt:
33 Who are secretors? Which gene makes them secretors?
(Secretors kaun hain? Kaun sa gene unhein secretor banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secretors woh log hain jo antigens A aur B jism ki raton jaise saliva, aansu aur peshab mein kharij karte hain. Un mein chromosome 19 par dominant secretor gene 'Se' hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Some people secrete antigens A and B in body fluids

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between the antibodies of the ABO system and the Rh system.
(ABO system aur Rh system ki antibodies mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: ABO antibodies qudrati tor par mojood hain; anti-Rh antibodies sirf exposure ke baad banti hain.

book_ref.quote: In ABO system, the production of anti-A and anti-B antibodies does not require any exposure to antigens

rows: Antigens se exposure ki zaroorat nahi
Sirf tab banti hain jab Rh-negative shakhs Rh-positive khoon se exposed ho
Rh-negative logon mein qudrati tor par nahi hotin

blocks.prompt:
35 Why does the plasma of a blood group AB person contain no anti-A or anti-B antibodies?
(Blood group AB wale shakhs ke plasma mein anti-A ya anti-B antibodies kyun nahi hotin?)
blocks.explanation: IᴬIᴮ genotype antigen-A aur antigen-B dono banata hai. Plasma mein sirf us antigen ki antibodies hoti hain jo shakhs mein na ho; AB mein dono hain, is liye plasma mein na anti-A na anti-B.

book_ref.quote: Genotype IᴬIᴮ produces both antigen-A and antigen-B

blocks.prompt:
36 In which transfusions between ABO groups does agglutination occur?
(ABO groups ke darmiyan kin transfusions mein agglutination hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Jab group A ko group B ka khoon mile aur is ka ulat.
2. Jab donor AB ho aur recipient A, B ya O.
Recipient ki antibodies donor ke RBC antigens par hamla kar ke RBCs ko jama deti hain.

book_ref.quote: If donor’s blood group is AB and the recipient is A, B, or O

blocks.prompt:
37 A man of genotype Iᴬi marries a woman of genotype Iᴮi. Write the possible blood groups of their children with the chance of each.
(Iᴬi mard ki shadi Iᴮi aurat se hoti hai. Un ke bachchon ke mumkin blood groups aur har aik ka imkan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Gametes: Iᴬ, i × Iᴮ, i. Bachche: IᴬIᴮ (AB) 1/4, Iᴬi (A) 1/4, Iᴮi (B) 1/4, ii (O) 1/4. Chaaron groups mumkin hain, har aik ka 25% imkan.

book_ref.quote: In a cross between heterozygous Iᴬi and Iᴮi, 25% offspring will have blood group O

blocks.prompt:
38 On what basis are people classified as Rh-positive and Rh-negative? Why is it called Rh?
(Log Rh-positive aur Rh-negative kis bunyad par hote hain? Ise Rh kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jin ke RBCs par Rh-antigen (Rh factor ya antigen-D) ho woh Rh-positive, jin mein na ho woh Rh-negative hain. Naam Rhesus bandar se hai jis mein Landsteiner ne pehli dafa yeh antigen paya.

book_ref.quote: This system is based on the presence or absence of Rh-antigen

blocks.prompt:
39 How is a blood group written using both ABO and Rh systems? Give two examples.
(ABO aur Rh dono systems ke saath blood group kaise likha jata hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Blood group mein dono systems ikatthe likhe jate hain. Antigen-A aur Rh-antigen wala A-positive; antigen-A ho magar Rh-antigen na ho to A-negative. B, AB aur O ka bhi yehi hai.

book_ref.quote: Usually, the blood group of an individual mentions both ABO and Rh systems together

blocks.prompt:
40 Write the genotypes of Rh-positive and Rh-negative persons. Which allele forms the Rh-antigen?
(Rh-positive aur Rh-negative logon ke genotypes likhein. Kaun sa allele Rh-antigen banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene D ke do alleles hain. Dominant D Rh-antigen banata hai, is liye DD aur Dd Rh-positive hain. Recessive d antigen nahi banata, is liye dd Rh-negative hai.

book_ref.quote: It has two alleles (D and d)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke d Rh-antigen ko rokta (inhibit) hai. Yeh sahi nahi: agar d rokta to Dd log Rh-negative hote, magar woh Rh-positive hain. Asal mein d bas antigen nahi banata.

blocks.prompt:
41 What happens if an Rh-negative person receives Rh-positive blood?
(Agar Rh-negative shakhs ko Rh-positive khoon diya jaye to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us ka jism anti-Rh antibodies banana shuru kar deta hai jo diye gaye RBCs ko tabah karti hain. Yeh antibodies saari umar jism mein rehti hain.

book_ref.quote: But, if Rh-negative person receives Rh-positive blood

blocks.prompt:
42 How do anti-Rh antibodies reach the foetus in erythroblastosis foetalis?
(Erythroblastosis foetalis mein anti-Rh antibodies foetus tak kaise pohanchti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rh-negative maan (dd) Rh-positive bachcha uthati hai. Foetus ka khoon maan ke khoon mein aa sakta hai; foetal Rh-antigens se exposed ho kar maan anti-Rh antibodies banati hai jo placenta paar kar ke foetus mein ja kar us ke RBCs tabah karti hain.

book_ref.quote: It occurs when Rh-negative mother (dd) carries Rh-positive baby (DD or Dd)

blocks.prompt:
43 Why does a foetus with erythroblastosis foetalis develop jaundice?
(Erythroblastosis foetalis wale foetus ko jaundice (yarqan) kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anti-Rh antibodies foetal RBCs tabah karti hain. RBCs tootne se bilirubin banta hai jo jama ho kar jaundice (peeli jild aur aankhein) karta hai. Zyada bilirubin dimaghi cells ko bhi nuqsan de sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: High bilirubin can also damage brain cells

blocks.prompt:
44 What is Rh-antiserum? When and why is it given to the mother?
(Rh-antiserum kya hai? Yeh maan ko kab aur kyun diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rh-antiserum anti-Rh antibodies wala serum hai. Rh-incompatibility ke imkan par yeh shuru hamal aur paidaish ke foran baad diya jata hai; yeh maan ke khoon mein aaye bachche ke RBCs ko us ke immune system ke sensitize hone se pehle tabah karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This causes the destruction of any of the baby

blocks.prompt:
45 What are polygenic characters? How do their alleles act?
(Polygenic characters kya hain? In ke alleles kaise kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polygenic characters aik nahi balke bohat se gene joron se control hote hain. Tamam alleles aik hi trait mein jama hone wale (additive) tareeqe se hissa dalte hain (kuch asar barhate, kuch ghatate); mila jula asar aik trait banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Polygenic characters are controlled by many gene pairs, not just one

blocks.prompt:
46 How do the alleles of the three genes A, B and C affect human skin colour?
(Teen genes A, B aur C ke alleles insaani jild ke rang par kya asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jild ka rang melanin par hai. Alleles A, B aur C zyada melanin (gehri jild) aur a, b, c kam melanin (halki jild) banate hain. AABBCC sab se gehra aur aabbcc sab se halka hai.

book_ref.quote: Alleles A, B, and C produce more melanin

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the ratio of skin colours in children of two AaBbCc parents. How many colour classes are there?
(Do AaBbCc parents ke bachchon mein jild ke rangon ka ratio likhein. Kitni rang ki classes hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ratio 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1 hai, bohat gehre se bohat halke tak. Saat rang ki classes hain (0 se 6 dark alleles), jin ka jama 64 hai.

book_ref.quote: If both parents are triple heterozygotes

blocks.prompt:
48 How do the alleles of the three polygenes control wheat grain colour?
(Teen polygenes ke alleles gandum ke daane ka rang kaise control karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har gene ka dominant allele (A, B, C) surkh pigment banata hai aur recessive (a, b, c) nahi. AABBCC sab se zyada pigment (gehre surkh daane); aabbcc koi pigment nahi (safaid daane).

book_ref.quote: Each gene has a dominant allele (A, B, C) that produces red pigment

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between allelic and non-allelic interactions of genes.
(Genes ki allelic aur non-allelic interactions mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Allelic interactions aik gene ke andar, non-allelic mukhtalif genes ke darmiyan hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Most traits appear due to interactions between different genes

rows: Aik hi gene ke alleles aapas mein asar dalte hain
Mukhtalif genes (mukhtalif loci) ke alleles aapas mein asar dalte hain
Misalein: incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between epistatic and hypostatic alleles with an example.
(Epistatic aur hypostatic alleles mein misaal ke saath farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Epistasis mein epistatic allele doosre gene ke hypostatic allele ko chhupata ya badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The allele which masks or modifies the effect is called epistatic

rows: Doosre gene ke alleles ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai
Is ka asar chhupa ya badla jata hai
Misaal: insaan mein baldness ka allele
Misaal: black aur blonde baalon ke alleles

blocks.prompt:
51 Write the roles of the B gene and the E gene in Labrador coat colour.
(Labrador ki khaal ke rang mein B gene aur E gene ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: B gene pigment ka rang control karta hai: B black, b brown. E gene baalon mein pigment ka jama hona control karta hai: E jama hone deta hai, ee rok deta hai, is liye ee kutte yellow hain chahe B ho ya b.

book_ref.quote: The E gene controls the deposition of pigment in fur

blocks.prompt:
52 What is the Bombay phenotype? Why does it appear as blood group O?
(Bombay phenotype kya hai? Yeh blood group O kyun dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene H, H substance banata hai jise Iᴬ aur Iᴮ ke enzymes antigen-A aur antigen-B mein badalte hain. Jis mein Iᴬ aur Iᴮ hon magar genotype hh ho woh H substance nahi banata, is liye A ya B antigens nahi bante aur O phenotype dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: It makes a particular H substance, which is a precursor to the A or B antigens

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bombay phenotype mein ABO genes theek hote hain, magar H substance (kachcha maadda) hi nahi banta. Is liye enzymes ke paas badalne ke liye kuch nahi hota aur khoon O jaisa lagta hai.

blocks.prompt:
53 Write the flower colours of the foxglove genotypes DDww, ddww and DdWw, with reasons.
(Foxglove ke genotypes DDww, ddww aur DdWw ke phoolon ke rang wajah ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: DDww: dark red (D gehra surkh pigment banata hai, ww yaksan phailata hai). ddww: light red (dd halka surkh, ww yaksan). DdWw: white (W pigment ko andar ki taraf chhote dhabbon tak mehdood karta hai).

book_ref.quote: Gene D has a dominant allele D that produces dark red petals

blocks.prompt:
54 Compare the epistatic ratios in Labrador coat colour and foxglove flower colour.
(Labrador ki khaal aur foxglove ke phool ke rang ke epistatic ratios ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono do genes ki epistasis hain, magar epistatic alleles aur ratios mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: If such heterozygous plant is self-fertilized

blocks.prompt:
55 Why must many genes be present on each chromosome? Give the human and Drosophila figures.
(Har chromosome par bohat se genes kyun hone chahiye? Insaan aur Drosophila ke adad dein.)
blocks.explanation: Hazaron genes mehdood chromosomes par hain: insaan mein taqreeban 20,000 genes 23 chromosomes par aur Drosophila mein taqreeban 13,000 genes 4 chromosomes par (har aik do sets mein). Is liye har chromosome par bohat se genes qatar mein hain.

book_ref.quote: This means many genes are arranged in a line on each chromosome

blocks.prompt:
56 How is gene linkage studied by crosses?
(Crosses ke zariye gene linkage kaise parha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crosses kiye jate hain aur aulad mein phenotypes ki frequency dekhi jati hai. Parental combinations (parents jaise) ka recombinant (naye) combinations se muqabla hota hai; bari tadaad mein aulad zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: The key idea is to compare parental combinations

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between complete linkage and incomplete linkage.
(Complete linkage aur incomplete linkage mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke koi naye (recombinant) combinations aate hain ya nahi.

book_ref.quote: If only parental combinations appear and no new combinations are seen

rows: Genes bohat qareeb aur alag nahi hote
Genes linked magar crossing over se alag ho sakte hain

blocks.prompt:
58 What did Morgan conclude from the F2 of his wing-length and abdomen-width cross?
(Morgan ne par ki lambai aur pet ki chaurai wale cross ke F2 se kya natija nikala?)
blocks.explanation: 9:3:3:1 ke bajaye sirf parental combinations aaye (3/4 lambe-chaura, 1/4 vestigial-patla). Is liye par ki lambai aur pet ki chaurai ke genes aik chromosome par hain aur azadana assort nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: From this data, Morgan concluded that the genes for wing length and abdomen width

blocks.prompt:
59 Why is crossing over responsible for genetic variability?
(Crossing over genetic variability (tanawwo) ka zimmedar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meiosis-I mein homologous chromosomes ke chromatids DNA ke hisse badalte hain, is liye linked genes ke alleles nayi tarteeb mein aate hain. Yeh recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein ja kar gametes mein bohat tanawwo paida karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This process is responsible for the recombination of linked genes

blocks.prompt:
60 Differentiate between autosomes and sex chromosomes.
(Autosomes aur sex chromosomes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Autosomes dono jinson mein aik jaise hain; aik jora, sex chromosomes, mukhtalif hai aur jins tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: One pair of chromosomes is different in female and male

rows: Female aur male mein bilkul aik jaise
Aik jora jo female aur male mein mukhtalif hai
Insaan aur Drosophila: 1 jora (XX ya XY)

blocks.prompt:
61 How is the sex of a child decided at fertilization in humans?
(Insaan mein fertilization par bachche ki jins kaise tay hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam ande aik X rakhte hain. X wala sperm fertilize kare to zygote XX ho kar female banta hai. Y wala sperm fertilize kare to zygote XY ho kar male banta hai.

book_ref.quote: If a sperm with Y chromosome fertilizes the egg

blocks.prompt:
62 Compare the male and female grasshopper in the XX-XO system.
(XX-XO system mein nar aur mada grasshopper ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Grasshopper mein nar ke paas Y nahi, is liye dono jinson mein chromosomes ki tadaad mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Female has 24 chromosomes

rows: Do qisam ke sperm: aadhe X wale, aadhe nullo

blocks.prompt:
63 In birds, which parent decides the sex of the offspring, and how?
(Parindon mein aulad ki jins kaun sa parent tay karta hai aur kaise?)
blocks.explanation: Mada (ZW) tay karti hai kyunke woh do qisam ke ande banati hai, aadhe Z wale aur aadhe W wale, jabke tamam sperms mein Z hai. Z anda nar (ZZ) aur W anda mada (ZW) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This sex determination is common in birds

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Y carrying egg' chhapa hai, magar parindon mein Y chromosome hota hi nahi. Mada dene wala anda W chromosome wala hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
64 Why is the ratio of sex-linked traits different in males and females, while pseudo-autosomal traits are equal?
(Sex-linked traits ka ratio mard aur aurat mein mukhtalif kyun hai, jabke pseudo-autosomal traits barabar hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sex-linked traits asal mein X-linked hain kyunke Y par taqreeban koi kaam ka gene nahi, is liye jinson mein ratio mukhtalif hai. Pseudo-autosomal (X-Y-linked) traits ke alleles X aur Y dono par hain, is liye barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: That’s why, the ratio of sex-linked traits is different in males and females

blocks.prompt:
65 How did Morgan prove that a female Drosophila could have white eyes?
(Morgan ne kaise sabit kiya ke mada Drosophila bhi safaid aankh wali ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us ne F1 surkh aankh mada ka safaid aankh nar se test-cross kiya aur safaid aur surkh aankh wale nar aur mada 1:1:1:1 mein paye, yani safaid aankh mada bhi aayi.

book_ref.quote: Morgan thought that perhaps it was impossible for a white-eyed female fly to exist

blocks.prompt:
66 What did Morgan conclude about the white-eye gene of Drosophila?
(Morgan ne Drosophila ke white-eye gene ke bare mein kya natija nikala?)
blocks.explanation: White eye ka gene X chromosome par hai aur Y par is ka allele nahi. Us ne aise genes ko sex-linked genes aur traits ko sex-linked traits kaha.

book_ref.quote: Morgan concluded that the gene of white-eye is present on X chromosome

blocks.prompt:
67 What is embryonic screening? Name its methods.
(Embryonic screening kya hai? Is ke tareeqon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Embryonic screening woh tareeqe hain jin se embryos mein genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghair mamooli tadaad check ki jati hai. Is mein ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Embryonic screening are the methods to check genetic disorders

blocks.prompt:
68 Describe briefly the procedure of amniocentesis.
(Amniocentesis ka tareeqa mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 15th-20th hafte mein: lambi suyi amniotic sac mein dali jati hai aur ultrasound probe foetus dhoondta hai. Suyi foetal cells wala amniotic fluid kheenchti hai; cells culture kar ke chromosomes ki ghair mamooli tadaad check hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The inserted needle sucks some amniotic fluid which contains cells of the foetus

blocks.prompt:
69 Why are X-linked recessive traits less common in females than males?
(X-linked recessive traits aurton mein mardon se kam kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aurat mein trait tab zahir hota hai jab us ke dono X chromosomes par recessive alleles hon. Mard mein X par aik allele kaafi hai kyunke Y par is ka allele nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: It is because, such trait will appear in a female only when she has two recessive alleles

blocks.prompt:
70 Differentiate between X-linked recessive and X-linked dominant traits.
(X-linked recessive aur X-linked dominant traits mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono X chromosome par hain, magar aik ko aurat mein do alleles chahiye aur doosre ko sirf aik.

book_ref.quote: If an X-linked dominant trait is present in mother

rows: Mutassir baap: tamam betiyan carriers, koi beta nahi
Mutassir baap: tamam betiyan mutassir, koi beta nahi
Misalein: haemophilia, red-green colour blindness, muscular dystrophy
Misalein: vitamin D-resistant rickets, Rett syndrome, Aicardi syndrome

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai X-linked dominant traits mard aur aurat mein barabar hain. Asal mein yeh aurton mein zyada (taqreeban dugne) hain, kyunke aurat ke do X hain. Aur 50% sirf heterozygous maan par lagta hai; homozygous maan har bachche ko trait deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
71 Why are Y-linked traits rare, and why do they pass only from father to son?
(Y-linked traits kam kyun hain aur sirf baap se bete ko kyun jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Y chromosome par X ke muqable mein bohat kam genes hain, is liye Y-linked traits kam hain. In ke genes sirf Y ke non-homologous hisse par hain jo sirf mardon mein hai aur sirf beta baap se leta hai.

book_ref.quote: That’s why Y-linked traits are relatively rare

blocks.prompt:
72 What is haemophilia? Why are haemophilia A and B more common in males?
(Haemophilia kya hai? Haemophilia A aur B mardon mein zyada kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Haemophilia mein chot ke baad khoon theek tarah nahi jamta, clotting factors ki kami, kharabi ya ghair mojoodgi ki wajah se. Type A (factor VIII) aur B (factor IX) X-linked recessive hain, is liye mardon mein zyada hain.

book_ref.quote: In this disease, the blood fails to clot properly after an injury

blocks.prompt:
73 Write the first three steps of normal blood clotting.
(Khoon jamne ke pehle teen qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Platelets chot ki jagah chipak kar platelet plug banate hain.
2. Active platelets aur zakhmi tissue clotting factors kharij karte hain.
3. Clotting factors clotting cascade mein soluble fibrinogen ko insoluble fibrin mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: When an injury occurs, platelets adhere to the site of injury, forming a platelet plug

blocks.prompt:
74 Differentiate between dichromacy and monochromacy.
(Dichromacy aur monochromacy mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono opsins ghayab hone se colour blindness hain; farq dekhe jane wale rangon ki tadaad mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Dichromacy: It is the perception of two primary colours

rows: Sirf aik rang ki pehchan (mukammal colour blindness)
Teesre rang ka andhapan jis ka opsin ghayab
Do rangon ka andhapan jin ke opsins ghayab
Qismein: blue-cone, red-cone aur green-cone monochromacy

blocks.prompt:
75 Can colour blindness be cured? What helps colour-blind people?
(Kya colour blindness ka ilaj hai? Colour-blind logon ki kis cheez se madad hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka koi ilaj nahi. Colour-blind glasses aur khaas software jaisi madadgar technologies rang pehchanne mein madad deti hain, aur kuch log colour discrimination training se kamyab hue hain.

book_ref.quote: There is no cure for colour blindness

blocks.prompt:
76 Which muscles are affected in Duchenne muscular dystrophy, and in what order?
(Duchenne muscular dystrophy mein kaun se muscles aur kis tarteeb se mutassir hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dystrophin na hone se muscle fibres mar jate hain. Kamzori pehle hips, pelvis, raanon aur pindliyon ke skeletal muscles mein, phir kandhon, gardan, bazuon, saans aur dil ke muscles tak phailti hai.

book_ref.quote: It results in the death of muscle fibres

blocks.prompt:
77 Name the treatments used to manage muscular dystrophy.
(Muscular dystrophy ko sambhalne ke ilaj ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ilaj nahi, magar: physical therapy (taqat, lachak, harkat); corticosteroids (thori muddat ki taqat); pain-killers (dard); surgery (joint contractures theek karne ke liye).

book_ref.quote: There is no cure for muscular dystrophy

blocks.prompt:
78 Give three human examples of sex-limited traits.
(Sex-limited traits ki teen insaani misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Darhi ka ugna (sirf mardon mein).
2. Prostate cancer ke genes (sirf mardon mein).
3. Ovarian cancer ke genes (sirf aurton mein).
Genes dono jinson mein mojood hain.

book_ref.quote: The genes of the growth of beard in humans are expressed in males only

blocks.prompt:
79 Write the genotypes of bald men and bald women (B = baldness allele). Why do they differ?
(Ganje mardon aur ganji aurton ke genotypes likhein (B = baldness allele). Farq kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ganje mard: BB ya Bb; ganji aurat: sirf BB. Baldness sex-influenced hai: is ka allele hormonal farq ki wajah se mardon mein dominant aur aurton mein recessive hai.

book_ref.quote: The allele of baldness is dominant in men but recessive in women

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein aurat ke liye 'bb' chhapa hai, magar B hi baldness allele hai. Is liye ganji aurat ko do baldness alleles chahiye, yani BB.
